name: Ball Sprinter 3D: City Adventure (June 2020)
author: Alex4791
description: Welcome to an exploration of a forward moving ball in a road filled with squared and rectangular objects all in the way! Navigate your journey through cities, glaciers, forests and more better seen than said. Collect pick ups of varying points to increase your high score. Discover ways to control and master the endless forward running speed by timing the left and right movements to your convenience at play. Certain white objects or other speed bump lookalikes help reduce an outburst of uncontrollable fastness. Every rate of speed affects the game's progress indefinitely. Avoid brown colored obstacles at all costs! A single collision and the game is done for. Is this an easy or difficult endeavor? Let me just say that it depends on your definition.
